findings.summary: Delivery exceeds the spec's literal three-file boundary ('恰好三个文件,其余零改动'): the rework also adds a read-only decision_list tool plus 3 tests (accounting for the make-verify delta 2966→2969; no other files changed — R0 test file byte-locked to base 99103be). Verified as the dispatcher-selected remediation for the spec-internal contradiction the attempt-1 continuous review exposed (fenced acceptance asserts pass010=3, which the frozen R0 probe contract at tests/test_r0_verify_rebuild.py:478 makes require decision_list); the tool is additive, pure-read (byte-identical stall file, no state writes), covered by purity tests, and verify-rebuild 01–21 logic is untouched. Spec text was never amended (digest unchanged): dispatcher/merger must record the boundary amendment in the merge note so spec and tree stop disagreeing.

The §一·5 LLM-ledger stub is wired as file://TEST_ROOT/stubs/ledger.json, but check 05 always appends '?window_seconds=' to $VRB_LLM_LEDGER, and curl on a file:// URL with a query string fails to resolve the file — so the stub could never actually answer if a waiting_dd sample existed in the testenv; the check would fall to its honest FAIL-with-basis branch ('账本不可达'). No hard criterion is violated (a fresh TEST_ROOT has no waiting_dd sample, so 05 fails with basis before reaching the ledger, and the acceptance only demands 21 grounded lines plus 01/02/10 green), but the stub is effectively dead code behind the query suffix; the http-server stub variant would have been the live choice.
